name.ar: برنامج الامتياز الطبي في مؤسسة حمد الطبية

stipend.en: Qataris are hired as employees with salary and benefits; non-Qataris join as non-employees with no remuneration and no HMC sponsorship

deadline_note: Rolling, two intakes: applications 16 May-15 Nov start 1 Jan; 16 Nov-15 May start 1 Jul (per HMC page, checked 2026-11-16).

summary.en: One-year hands-on medical internship at Hamad Medical Corporation, Qatar's main public hospital provider, for recent medical graduates. Training is in English with four mandatory rotations and two electives.
summary.ka: ერთწლიანი პრაქტიკული სამედიცინო ინტერნატურა ჰამადის სამედიცინო კორპორაციაში, ყატარის მთავარ სახელმწიფო საავადმყოფოების ქსელში, ახალგაზრდა მედიკოსებისთვის.
summary.ar: سنة امتياز طبي عملية في مؤسسة حمد الطبية لخريجي كليات الطب الجدد، بتدريب باللغة الإنجليزية وأربع تناوبات إلزامية واختيارين.

about.en:
The HMC Medical Internship is a one-year (thirteen-block) programme for newly qualified doctors. It includes four mandatory rotations (Internal Medicine, General Surgery, Pediatrics, Obstetrics and Gynecology) and two electives, and ends with a Certificate of Completion of Medical Internship.

Applicants must have graduated from a medical school in the World Directory of Medical Schools within the past five years (final-year students may apply if they graduate before the start date) and hold a minimum clinical exam score (USMLE Step 2 CK 172, IFOM CSE, or MCC QE Part 1 pass) plus an English score (IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80 or OET Medical C+). Selection is competitive and based mainly on those scores.

Selected interns must be physically in Qatar for six weeks before the start date for onboarding and cannot take leave in the first three months. Applications are accepted year-round with two start dates.

en: One-year rotating internship at Qatar's largest public healthcare provider
Applications year-round; starts 1 January or 1 July
No joining fee; Qataris are salaried employees
ka: ერთწლიანი როტაციული ინტერნატურა ყატარის უდიდეს სახელმწიფო სამედიცინო ქსელში
განაცხადები მთელი წლის განმავლობაში; დაწყება 1 იანვარს ან 1 ივლისს
გადასახადი არ არის; ყატარელები ხელფასიან თანამშრომლებად მიიღებიან
ar: سنة امتياز بالتناوب في أكبر مزود للرعاية الصحية العامة في قطر
التقديم طوال العام؛ البدء في 1 يناير أو 1 يوليو
لا رسوم انضمام؛ القطريون يعملون كموظفين بمرتب

eligibility.en: Qatari citizens, GCC citizens, or holders of a valid Qatar residency permit under first-degree family sponsorship only. Medical graduates (within 5 years) or final-year students graduating before the start date; clinical exam and English scores as above. Non-medical graduates (nursing, pharmacy) are not eligible. Previous HMC interns are not eligible.

how_to_apply: Check the eligibility and exam-score requirements on the HMC Internship Program page
Apply online through the HMC application portal (paper applications are not accepted)
Submit before 15 Nov for a 1 January start, or before 15 May for a 1 July start
Selected candidates are notified by 20 Nov / 20 May and must be in Qatar six weeks before starting
Questions: internship@hamad.qa (Sunday-Thursday, Qatar time)

costs.en: No fee to join. Qataris receive salary and benefits; non-Qataris receive no remuneration and are not sponsored by HMC.

score_reason: Prestigious, open to residents and GCC citizens, rolling; unpaid for non-Qataris.

deadline_note: Annual: HMC page states a 15 October deadline, notification 31 October, start 1 January. The 2026 date has passed; 15 Oct 2027 is the expected next date, confirm on the page.

summary.en: Annual internship for newly graduated dentists at HMC, rotating through six dental specialties. Open to Qatari and GCC citizens and residents with first-degree family sponsorship.

summary.ar: برنامج امتياز سنوي لأطباء الأسنان حديثي التخرج في مؤسسة حمد الطبية بالتناوب على ست تخصصات.

about.en:
The HMC Dental Internship gives new dental graduates supervised rotations in Periodontics, Orthodontics, Endodontics, Prosthodontics, Pedodontics and Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery. There is one intake a year starting on 1 January.

Applicants need a BDS or equivalent from a recognised school obtained within the past three years (final-year students may apply if they graduate before the start), a pass in the Ministry of Public Health DHP General Dentist Qualifying Exam, and an English score (IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80 or OET Dentistry C+). Applications must be complete, with all exam scores, before submission.

en: One intake a year, starting 1 January
Rotations in six dental specialties
Deadline 15 October, results by 31 October
ar: دفعة واحدة سنويا تبدأ في 1 يناير
آخر موعد 15 أكتوبر والإعلان بحلول 31 أكتوبر

eligibility.en: Qatari or GCC citizens, or holders of a valid Qatar residency permit under first-degree family sponsorship. Employer-sponsored applicants and international applicants without valid Qatari residency are not accepted. BDS (or equivalent) within the past three years; DHP General Dentist Qualifying Exam passed; English score as stated. Previous HMC dental interns are ineligible.

how_to_apply: Pass the DHP General Dentist Qualifying Exam and get a valid English score
Follow the procedure on the programme's How to Apply page on hamad.qa
Submit a complete application with all exam scores by 15 October
Queries: falabdulla4@hamad.qa (Sunday-Thursday, Qatar time)

costs.en: The page does not state pay or fees.

score_reason: Real annual programme with exact residency rules; narrow audience, pay not stated.

about.en:
Commercial Bank of Qatar's Student Sponsorship Programme supports bachelor's students with monthly financial support, a four-week internship each year for real business exposure, and direct placement in a position at the bank after graduation with no job search.

It is a nationality-restricted programme for Qatari nationals. Applicants apply through the bank's SuccessFactors career portal via the Apply Now link on the programme page.

en: Monthly financial support while studying
Four-week internship every year
Guaranteed placement at the bank after graduation
ar: ضمان التوظيف في البنك بعد التخرج

eligibility.en: Qatari nationals or individuals born to Qatari mothers only. Must be pursuing a bachelor's degree, have completed the second year of university, and have a minimum GPA of 3.00. Not open to other nationalities.

how_to_apply: Check you meet the nationality, year-of-study and GPA rules
Click Apply Now on the programme page (bank career portal)
Contact Learning and Development at the bank (marweh.fooladi@cbq.qa, +974 4449 0074) with questions

costs.en: Free to join; the bank pays monthly support (amount not published).

The page gives no nationality rule, pay or application method; contact Kahramaa through its contact page or WhatsApp 30303991.

Maharat 2026 was launched on 11 July 2026 by the Ministry of Labour's Qualifying and Skills Development Department with private-sector partners, across sectors including financial services, logistics, manufacturing, construction, education, tourism, IT and healthcare. Participating banks in the 2023 scheme included QIIB and Doha Bank.

It is for Qatari secondary and university students and children of Qatari women who register on the Ministry's website. Dates, stipend and registration deadlines were not stated in press coverage.
